data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Orsa is the name of a she-bear who was the mother of the legendary hero Heracles (Hercules). The name Orsa is derived from the Greek word for 'bear'. The name Orsa carries the meaning “Bear, she-bear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Orsa usually hope their child will grow to embody bear, she-bear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
